component.name: Photo Selector
component.summary: High-performance photograph culling and selection suite

description.p: Photo Selector is a native GNOME desktop application designed for rapid photograph culling, side-by-side comparison, and noise-corrected optical quality assessment on Debian 13.
Features tactile keyboard routing, 1-Up / 2-Up / 3-Up comparison modes, and non-destructive transactional file operations with copy-undo safety.
